title: Exact-curved Lagrange finite elements for the Poisson problem in two dimensions
summary: Conforming mapped Lagrange finite elements of any fixed degree are analysed for the Poisson problem on exact curved triangulations in two dimensions. The element map is factorised into an anisotropic affine core map and a smooth curved correction. Assuming compatible edge parametrisations, semi-regular affine cores and uniform bounds on the curved corrections, we obtain anisotropic $L^2$- and $H^1$-interpolation estimates with constants independent of the aspect ratios of the cores.
